text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty high-severity: 5xx error-rate spike on `inference-proxy-prod-usw2` - current 5xx rate 7.8% (alert threshold 2.0%). Auto-pager fired and escalated to oncall. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

alice-oncall: acked. I'm hopping in. First check: any deploys in last 15m? :hourglass: 

ben-sre: no deploys. I'm seeing repeated upstream 502/504 from kv-proxy pool. Quick query: `sum(rate(http_responses{code=~"5..",service="inference-proxy"}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="inference-proxy"}[1m]))` -> 0.078.

charlie-platform: adding context: we had higher traffic from a small customer burst 10m ago (weighting change). Rate-limiter counters jumped. Could be backpressure cascade.

alice-oncall: okay, can we confirm customer impact? dana-support, any alerts from customer-facing monitors or chats?

dana-support: one customer reported intermittent failures in chat widget (ticket #7894). Not widespread yet but seeing retries in logs. ETA to notify customers if it grows? 15-20m.

ben-sre: running quick health checks on kv-proxy nodes. One node in az-b shows elevated 5xx and high mem (evictions). Suspect prefix cache thrash.

alice-oncall: plan: 1) divert new traffic away from az-b by adjusting route weight, 2) scale kv-proxy replica set + restart the problematic pod, 3) enable temporary 20s retry-backoff on clients. Charlie, can you do route change? Ben, take the restart/scale.

charlie-platform: routing change applied: reduced weight for az-b from 0.33 -> 0.05. Watching for drop in 5xx.

ben-sre: scaled kv-proxy from 6 -> 9 replicas and restarted pod kv-proxy-azb-7. Logs show `OOMKilled` before restart. Heap growth around large batch requests. Pushed a hotfix to reduce batch size at proxy ingress (env OVERRIDE_BATCH=64).

alice-oncall: good. I'm also enabling a soft throttle on a noisy customer (id:cust-42) to reduce burstiness. Dana, please prepare a brief note if we need to inform them.

dana-support: drafting slack DM and email template now. Will hold until we confirm stabilization.

ben-sre: immediate effect: 5xx rate down to 3.5% after scaling and route change. Still above threshold. KV cache warmup ongoing; some steady decrease in miss rate.

charlie-platform: added temporary fallback route to a compatible model variant in eu-west for overflow traffic (minor latency increase). Metrics show overall request success rising.

alice-oncall: excellent. Keep monitoring for 15m. If 5xx < 2% for 10m, we'll start rollback of throttles and routing. If it bounces back, we'll escalate to infra-owners for deeper root cause.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note added: `ack by alice-oncall, mitigation routing + scale in progress, follow-up required`. Incident set to acknowledged.

ben-sre: 10m check -> 5xx at 1.4%. Looks stable. I'll keep the extra replicas for 30m then scale down.

alice-oncall: thanks team. Dana, hold customer comms as "investigating, mitigation applied, monitoring" for now. I'll close the pager in 20m if stable. :white_check_mark:

dana-support: message ready. Sending to cust-42 now.

charlie-platform: rollback route weight to az-b 0.25 -> keeping tiny less than normal for 15m to avoid thrash.

alice-oncall: closing note: incident resolved for now, follow-up action items: 1) postmortem to examine kv-proxy memory growth and batch-handling, 2) run chaos test for route-weight flapping, 3) add alert for proxy OOM spikes. I'll create the incident ticket and assign owners.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident closed by alice-oncall at 9887654600.
